question.prompt: The central angles of 3 sectors in a pie chart are in the ratio \(1:2:3\). What percentage of the total does the largest sector account for? (Enter only the number, without %.)

solutions.explanation: The central angles of the 3 sectors sum to \(360^\circ\). The largest accounts for \(3/(1+2+3)=1/2\), which is 50% (\(180^\circ\)).
solutions.title: Compare ratio parts
